criterion: Produces a design document in docs/plans/ (or complete design specification in the response) without altering existing production files under catalogcache/.
References the existing classes and methods in catalogcache/store.py (CatalogStore, BundleCache, SkuRecord, BundleView) and identifies the missing SKU-to-bundle reverse index.
Evaluates at least two distinct invalidation strategies (such as explicit reverse-dependency index vs version-epoch tagging vs TTL-only) with concrete complexity and memory trade-offs.
Addresses edge cases where one SKU belongs to multiple bundles and ensures reverse-index entries are cleaned up when bundles are evicted or rebuilt.
Specifies deterministic unit test scenarios covering single-SKU updates, multi-bundle shared SKUs, and cache re-population after invalidation.
